items.title: Woman alleges officer demanded Sh10,000 bribe before arresting suspect in 14-year-old defilement case
items.snippet: A woman went to report a defilement case involving her 14-year-old sister and a 50-year-old man. At the OB, she claims a female officer demanded Sh10,000 before the suspect could be arrested. When she could not pay, she was told to leave or risk being locked up.

items.title: DPP charges Lumakanda OCS with defilement of 14-year-old girl
items.snippet: The Director of Public Prosecutions (DPP) has today charged the Officer Commanding Station (OCS) of Lumakanda Police Station with defilement of a 14-year-old girl in Lugari Sub-County, Kakamega County.

items.title: Lumakanda OCS charged under Sexual Offences Act for defilement of 14-year-old
items.snippet: Lumakanda OCS has been charged with defilement contrary to Section 8(1) as read with Section 8(3) of the Sexual Offences Act No. 3 of 2006. He is also facing an alternative charge of committing an indecent act with a child, a 14 year old, contrary to Section 11(1).
